name: President of Kazakhstan
description: Executive head of state of Kazakhstan and commander-in-chief of the Armed Forces; chairs the Security Council.

name: Government of Kazakhstan
description: Collegial body exercising executive power; current cabinet headed by Prime Minister sworn in on 6 Feb 2024. Government House at Mangilik El 8, Astana.

name: Government Apparatus of Kazakhstan
description: State body coordinating the activities of state bodies and exercising control functions, headed by a Deputy Prime Minister.

key_people.title: Deputy Prime Minister - Head of the Government Apparatus
key_people.name: Galymzhan Koishybayev

name: Kurultai of Kazakhstan
description: Unicameral parliament of Kazakhstan introduced by the new constitution approved at the 15 March 2026 referendum; replaced the bicameral Parliament (Senate and Mazhilis).

name: Parliament of Kazakhstan (former, abolished 2026)
aliases: Parliament of the Republic of Kazakhstan
description: Former bicameral legislature consisting of the Senate (upper house) and Mazhilis (lower house); abolished under the new constitution effective 2026 and replaced by the unicameral Kurultai.

name: Supreme Court of Kazakhstan
aliases: Supreme Court of the Republic of Kazakhstan
description: Highest court of Kazakhstan sitting above regional appeals courts and city/district courts; judges nominated by the Supreme Judicial Council.

name: Constitutional Court of Kazakhstan
aliases: Constitutional Court of the Republic of Kazakhstan
description: State body outside the judicial system responsible for upholding the Constitution of Kazakhstan.

name: Prosecutor General's Office of Kazakhstan
description: Highest prosecutorial authority overseeing enforcement of legality throughout the country.

name: Security Council of Kazakhstan
aliases: Security Council of the Republic of Kazakhstan
description: Constitutional advisory body assisting the President in implementation of military policy and law enforcement.

name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Kazakhstan
description: Oversees the foreign relations of Kazakhstan.

name: Ministry of Defense of Kazakhstan
description: Main executive body implementing military policy; exercises administrative leadership of the Armed Forces.

name: Ministry of Internal Affairs of Kazakhstan
Ministry of National Economy of Kazakhstan
Ministry of Science and Higher Education of Kazakhstan
Ministry of Labour and Social Protection of the Population of Kazakhstan
Ministry of Trade and Integration of Kazakhstan
Ministry of Industry and Construction of Kazakhstan
Ministry for Emergency Situations of Kazakhstan
Ministry of Ecology and Natural Resources of Kazakhstan
Ministry of Culture and Information of Kazakhstan
Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation of Kazakhstan
Ministry of Tourism and Sports of Kazakhstan
Ministry of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Development of Kazakhstan
Samruk-Kazyna
description: Sovereign Wealth Fund 'Samruk-Kazyna' JSC; state holding owning wholly or partially major national companies including rail, postal services, oil and gas, uranium, and the flag carrier Air Astana. Government of Kazakhstan is sole shareholder. Established 2008 by merger of SAMRUK and KAZYNA funds.

name: KazMunayGas
description: State-owned oil and gas company of Kazakhstan, founded 2002 by merging Kazakhoil and Oil&Gas Transportation. Largest company in Kazakhstan by market capitalization as of 2025.

name: Qazaqstan Temir Zholy (Kazakhstan Temir Zholy)
description: State-owned railway company founded in 1997, owning and managing all rail infrastructure and operating freight and passenger services with a near-monopoly on long-distance train travel.

name: Kazatomprom
description: National Atomic Company Kazatomprom JSC, the world's largest producer and seller of natural uranium, providing over 40% of global primary uranium supply (2019).

name: KEGOC
description: Kazakhstan Electricity Grid Operating Company, an Astana-based state joint-stock company established in 1997; operates the national power grid.

name: KazTransOil
description: National oil transporter accounting for 53% of oil transported in Kazakhstan; operates over 8,000 km of oil pipelines. Subsidiary of KazMunayGas.

name: KazPost
description: National postal operator of Kazakhstan; postal services named among national companies owned by Samruk-Kazyna.

name: Baiterek Holding
description: Baiterek National Management Holding, a state-owned financial and development institution supporting economic modernization, diversification, entrepreneurship and industrial development; manages several national development institutions.

name: Qazaq Air
description: Kazakh airline based in Astana operating scheduled domestic and international services including subsidised routes under a state programme; branded Vietjet Qazaqstan since 2025.

name: Air Astana
description: Flag carrier airline of Kazakhstan headquartered in Almaty; founded 2001 as JV between Samruk-Kazyna (51%) and BAE Systems (49%); dual-listed on Astana International Exchange and London Stock Exchange since 2024.

name: Kazakhtelecom
description: Largest telecommunication company in Kazakhstan.

name: Kazakhmys
description: Vertically integrated holding company in mining and non-ferrous metallurgy; established as JSC in August 1997; split into Kazakhmys Corporation LLP and KAZ Minerals Plc in 2014.

name: Eurasian Resources Group
description: Large mining and raw materials supplier with operations in Kazakhstan, Brazil and Central Africa; formed 2013 acquiring ENRC. Republic of Kazakhstan holds 40%.

name: Tengizchevroil
description: Joint venture between Chevron, ExxonMobil, KazMunayGas and Lukoil, formed April 1993 with exclusive 40-year rights to develop the Tengiz and Korolevskoye oil fields.

name: Qarmet
description: Kazakhstani integrated steel and mining company owning the Karaganda Metallurgical Plant in Temirtau, the largest steel plant in Kazakhstan; owned by the Qazaqstan Investment Corporation since December 2023 (previously ArcelorMittal Temirtau).

name: ARGO - Civil Society Development Association
description: Kazakhstan civil society development association registered in 2004, uniting CSO resource centers across Kazakhstan and expanding into Central Asia and post-Soviet states.

name: Adil Soz
aliases: International Foundation for Protection of Freedom of Speech 'Adil Soz'
description: Kazakh NGO (Adil Soz Foundation) addressing corruption in law and politics; a media watchdog and the only Central Asian member of IFEX. Goal: open civil society and free, objective journalism in Kazakhstan.

name: Kazakhstan International Bureau for Human Rights and Rule of Law
aliases: Kazakhstan International Bureau for Human Rights
description: Human rights NGO and FIDH member organization operating in Kazakhstan.

name: Nevada-Semipalatinsk (Anti-nuclear Movement)
description: Anti-nuclear movement formed 1989, one of the first major anti-nuclear movements in the former Soviet Union; led by Olzhas Suleimenov and led to closure of the Semipalatinsk Test Site in 1991.

name: Nazarbayev University
description: Autonomous English-medium research university in Astana, founded by former President Nursultan Nazarbayev on 28 June 2010.

name: Al-Farabi Kazakh National University
description: National research university in Almaty, named after philosopher al-Farabi; one of the country's largest universities; ranked top in Central Asia (QS Central Asia 2026).

name: L. N. Gumilyov Eurasian National University
description: Kazakh national research university and the largest higher education institution in Astana.

name: Satbayev University
aliases: Kazakh National Research Technical University named after K.I. Satpayev
description: Oldest technical university in Kazakhstan, located in Almaty, comprising 10 institutions and 27 departments.

name: Almaty Management University
description: Higher educational institution in Almaty providing economics, MBA and DBA programs.

name: Kazakh National Agrarian Research University
description: Agrarian research university in Almaty; listed among top Kazakh universities by Times Higher Education.

name: Qazaqstan (TV Channel)
description: Kazakh state and international television broadcaster which began broadcasting on 8 March 1958; part of the Qazaqstan Radio and Television Corporation; broadcasts around the clock in Kazakh.

name: Khabar Agency
description: Major media outlet established in 1995 as the National Television News Agency; one of the largest networks in the country broadcasting in Kazakh, Russian and English; runs Jibek Joly TV.

name: Kazinform
description: Kazakh international news agency based in Astana; state-owned; since 2022 reorganized into the Television and Radio Complex of the President of Kazakhstan; publishes in Kazakh, Russian, English and Chinese.

name: Tengrinews
description: Widely recognized private digital news portal in Kazakhstan, founded 2008 by Effective Media; English edition at en.tengrinews.kz.

name: The Astana Times
description: Leading English-language news outlet about Kazakhstan and Central Asia for international decision makers.

name: Kursiv
description: Kazakh business and economics media outlet (kz.kursiv.media) covering finance, companies and markets.

name: National Bank of Kazakhstan
description: Central bank of Kazakhstan.

name: Halyk Bank
description: Kazakhstan's largest bank by assets and deposits (about 30% of sector assets at end-2023); commercial savings bank, legal successor of Soviet-era Sberbank in Kazakhstan; headquartered in Almaty with branches across Central Asia.

name: Kaspi.kz
description: Kazakh fintech unicorn comprising Kaspi Shop LLP, Kaspi Bank JSC, Kaspi Pay LLP and Kaspi Travel LLP; Kaspi Bank is the second largest bank in Kazakhstan.

name: Bank CenterCredit
description: One of the largest banks in Kazakhstan (ranked third in the national banks list).

name: Jusan Bank
description: One of the larger banks in Kazakhstan (included in the national banks list).

name: Astana International Financial Centre
description: Financial hub in Astana that officially launched on 5 July 2018 with its own legal framework and courts; hosts the Astana International Exchange.

name: Eurasian Development Bank
description: International multilateral financial organisation contributing to market-economy development of member countries; headquartered in Almaty.

name: Conference on Interaction and Confidence-Building Measures in Asia (CICA)
description: Asian multilateral forum for security dialogue and confidence-building; Secretariat headquartered in Astana.

name: Islamic Organisation for Food Security
description: OIC-affiliated international organisation working to ensure food security in member states; Secretariat operational since 1 March 2018, headquartered in Astana.

name: Adilet Party
description: Pro-presidential party registered in June 2026; absorbed the ruling Amanat party by merger in June 2026 and won the August 2026 parliamentary election.

name: Amanat
description: Formerly Nur Otan; largest political association in Kazakhstan with around 800,000 members and majority of Mazhilis seats; voted on 12 June 2026 to merge into the newly formed Adilet party and dissolved.

name: Auyl People's Democratic Patriotic Party
description: Political party originally founded by Gani Qaliev on 30 January 2000; led by Qairat Aituğanov; entered the Mazhilis at the 2023 election with eight seats, becoming the largest opposition party; supports agrarian interests.

name: Ak Zhol Democratic Party
description: Liberal-conservative political party; led by Mazhilis deputy Dania Espaeva since June 2026.

name: People's Party of Kazakhstan
description: Social democratic and progressive political party (former Communist Party of Kazakhstan lineage); chaired by Nursultan Şoqanov.

name: Respublica
description: Political party in Kazakhstan officially registered on 18 January 2023.

name: Armed Forces of the Republic of Kazakhstan
description: Unified armed forces of Kazakhstan consisting of three branches plus independent formations; act under the authority of the Ministry of Defense.

name: National Security Committee of Kazakhstan
description: Intelligence agency founded 13 July 1992; manages the Border Service of Kazakhstan and oversees the Arystan commando unit; part of the unified system of national security bodies.
